result.stdout:
theneo-scan — generate an OpenAPI 3.1 document from ASP.NET Core source.

Usage:
  theneo-scan build [options]   Scan once and write the document
  theneo-scan dev   [options]   Rescan on save (watch mode: later build)

Options:
  -p, --project <path>   Path to the .csproj to scan (or set in theneo-scan.json)
  -o, --out <path>       Output file path (default: openapi.json)
  -r, --root <path>      Project root for config + relative paths (default: cwd)
      --verbose          Print per-step detail
  -h, --help             Show this help
